title: The People of Israel Ask for a King
description: When Samuel grew old and his sons did not follow his ways, the elders of Israel gathered in Ramah and demanded a king like all the other nations. Samuel was displeased and prayed to the Lord, who said that the people had rejected Him as their king. Samuel warned the people about the burdens of kingship, but they insisted on their demand, so the Lord told him to grant them a king.
